fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x1A68ED0 (ecl::timeline::EventFrequencySystem update; registration bg3.exe+0x747030 lists the component as written, callback bg3.exe+0x761B60) fetches the singleton with stride 0x40. Loop 1: for every key (4 bytes, array at +0x20, count +0x2C) it subtracts the frame delta (GameTime + 8) from the float value (array at +0x30, stride 4) and removes the entry (bg3.exe+0xBDBA40, swap with last) when it reaches <= 0. Loop 2: for every row of a query over a 0x288-byte component it takes the 4-byte id at component + 0x28, finds its definition (bg3.exe+0xE7D7C0, a FixedString-hashed lookup through bg3.exe+0x412E1F0 in the object at system + 0x10) and inserts id -> the float at definition + 0x1C (bg3.exe+0x7D20D0). Probe: empty. Key type confirmed: the insert bg3.exe+0x7D20D0 hashes the key with the FixedString hash bg3.exe+0x412E1F0 (global string table lookup, 0 for -1) and pushes it with bg3.exe+0x78C8A0, which calls ls::FixedString::IncRef on it (key array grown by FUN_1405C4050, the Array<FixedString> resize).
